name: ai_sandwich

replace.How to turn: the best AI workflow is a

_title_why: guide title option 1, 'The best AI workflow is a double-decker sandwich'. The paper row 'Sandwich' measures 728.6px of the 944.3px the donor allows (77%). gap_after places 'decker' at the template's own word gap rather than a constant, so the model's width bias cancels.
_sfx_why: no Class A sound anywhere in this video - app scroll, click scroll, realistic typing and the mouse sounds each promise a screen recording, and there is none in this cut.

beats.why: 'AI can build pretty much anything now'. Lower band so it clears the title, which holds until 3.80.

beats.label: Painfully average
beats.why: error is Class C and lands on 'painfully average' (5.04).
'but it should never be' - the side-eye lands before the judging verdict at 9.32, so the two read as reaction then ruling.

beats.label: Never the final judge
beats.why: on 'the final judge' (9.32 final / 9.60 judge). Window sized to the clip's real 0.8s so the trim leaves no hole.

beats.label: Not AI's call
beats.why: she lists four criteria in 2.3s - too fast to split into four cards without each reading as a flicker, and they are meant to be taken in as a set.

beats.label: Taste and judgment
beats.why: the ACTION is tasting to judge. bulb is the realisation.

beats.label: The AI Sandwich
beats.why: the hero concept reveal, on 'the concept is called the AI sandwich'. No annotation: box_red's ink is 3.2:1 and a full-width card row is 16.7:1, so fitting the width scaled the box 5x too tall and it covered the whole card.

beats.label: Or 50-decker
beats.why: drawn rather than sourced - the three tall-sandwich clips Tenor returned were a stock ad, a clip with burned text, and a cartoon lobster.

beats.label: You set the standard
beats.why: beats 13-16 are the guide's beats 5-8, one card per clause: You set / AI builds / You check / AI revises.
left long on purpose - the engine wraps and scales a paper label to fit.

beats.label: Remove yourself
beats.why: 'remove yourself from the equation' (33.72 remove). The ACTION is vanishing.

beats.label: Pull it back on course
beats.why: carries the beat because all three dog-on-a-leash candidates had burned text or a watermark. No annotation: same aspect mismatch - the correction region is 8.9:1 against circle_sign's 1.3:1, so the circle swallowed the caption.
left long on purpose - the engine wraps and scales a paper label to fit.
five rapid labels on her five spoken items - pop is the sound for rapid succession.
whisper heard 'eviles' at 42.86 - it is 'evals'. On the caption fix list.
no label - the card already reads 'eval = a repeatable test', which is the guide's own overlay text.

beats.label: Earns more freedom
beats.why: 'earns more freedom on a task' (47.72 freedom).

_dropped_sw_split: collided with the CTA once cards moved into the raised band (card y 0.202-0.677 against CTA 0.441-0.601). At the end of a reel the CTA should own the screen - a two-column card splits attention exactly where you want one action.
